title: Almonte Curling Club
specs: One of the oldest curling clubs in Canada, founded 1855
Four-sheet curling rink with excellent ice maintained by hired icemaker
Junior U18 league open to curlers up to 17 years old
Junior U21 league open to curlers 18-20 years old
Clean indoor sneakers required for Junior U18 league
Lounge rental suitable for 10 to 130 people (LCBO max 126 persons)
Ice rental available for single or multiple sheets, one-time or multiple times

blurb: Guests can join various curling leagues for all skill levels, including instructional programs for new curlers and juniors. The club offers ice and lounge rentals for social and business events. The facility has four sheets of ice and a lounge accommodating up to 130 people.
extraNote: $80 volunteer fee included in membership; refunded after volunteering or kept if not volunteered · If you can’t make a game in fixed leagues, you are expected to find a spare from the spares list · October through March
